item.title: Quantum Sky Appoints Sean Thompson as Chief Growth Officer
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Quantum Sky (“Company,” formerly Tyto Athene, LLC), a mission technology integrator building quantum-ready capabilities for government agencies and a portfolio company of Arlington Capital Partners (“Arlington”), today announced the appointment of Sean Thompson as Chief Growth Officer (“CGO”).
